messages.text:
The mobile failure is not a build/type issue; it is touch interaction behavior.

I’m replacing the fragile article-as-button pattern with real explicit buttons for preview/drawer so touch devices and accessibility tree agree, then I’ll rerun the mobile-inclusive e2e.
